dedupe_keys.name: sub feflow hydro mechanical plug in

description: SUB+ is a C++ plug-in that extends the FEFLOW groundwater modeller with coupled hydro-mechanical calculations. Its project publishes source, benchmarks and a companion PSUB result viewer. Users define an aquifer mesh, hydraulic and mechanical properties, extraction conditions, boundaries and time steps in FEFLOW. SUB+ calculates groundwater and ground-deformation responses using poroelasticity, including land subsidence caused by pumping. Coverage and spatial and temporal resolution follow the user’s FEFLOW case, not a built-in region or period. The current public repository displays an MIT licence, so this source code is free to obtain. A paper-associated manual instead labels the older plug-in LGPL without a version; historical release terms remain uncertain. FEFLOW and its SDK are separate dependencies with their own access and possible cost. The results could support assessment of subsidence exposure for groundwater supply, roads or buildings. A limitation is that accuracy depends on aquifer parameters and FEFLOW compatibility; no field validation was independently checked. No related catalogue record was identified. No plug-in or FEFLOW model was run.
inputs: FEFLOW aquifer geometry, mesh, groundwater conditions and material properties
Time steps and hydraulic/mechanical boundary conditions
